name: A mapped field named like a sequence column is shadowed by it

body.query: EQL eql_join_keys "sequence by pid [process where true] [network where true]" METADATA _source WITH {"size": 1} | EVAL mapped = JSON_EXTRACT(_source, "join_keys") | KEEP _sequence_stage, join_keys, mapped | SORT _sequence_stage

headers.warning: 299 Elasticsearch-9.7.0-f32a27b4a5e121cb763322e50120d455866bf3d6 "No limit defined, adding default limit of [1000]", 299 Elasticsearch-9.7.0-f32a27b4a5e121cb763322e50120d455866bf3d6 "Line 1:1: Mapped field [join_keys] is shadowed by the EQL command's column of the same name; read it with FROM, or with JSON_EXTRACT on METADATA _source if the document stores it"
